curriculum_prerequisite.policy: C0-C5 evidence may be collected early, but normal curriculum progression still requires Day15 M1-M5; C5 does not backfill those curriculum gates.

candidate_container.reference_type: observed boot-runtime fingerprint, not an OCI digest
candidate_container.runtime_policy: run Day18 from the isolated /root/autodl-tmp/qwen35-v2/venv; the boot-image torch is inventory only

candidate_direct_dependencies.torch: 2.10.0+cu126 (isolated Day18 prefix; exact build recorded at runtime)
candidate_direct_dependencies.decord_policy: excluded: text-only Day18 does not use video readers and decord 0.6.0 has an invalid cp36 wheel tag on Python 3.12
candidate_direct_dependencies.lock_policy: candidate until bootstrap pip freeze, pip check, CUDA imports, and GDN probe pass

training.checkpoint_policy: C2-C4 retain optimizer/RNG for compatibility and resume evidence; C5 saves only its final model because it is an independent learnability gate, not resume evidence.

C0.action: HF to MCore conversion and inventory

C1.action: both fixed rows: logits, weighted main loss, and exact 15-tensor MTP conversion round-trip

C5.initialization: independent restart from C0 converted Base
C5.evaluation: fresh-process HF export/reload on the exact frozen two-row fixture
C5.ownership: relative to the C1 HF conversion round-trip baseline, main language and MTP tensors must change while every visual/aligner tensor remains bitwise exact
C5.claim_scope: same-fixture pipeline learnability only; not generalization or exact-resume evidence

resource_envelope.gpu: same-host exactly 2x H800 80GB or exactly 2x H100 80GB

hard_stops: AutoDL boot image reference, isolated runtime, or resolved dependency drift
processor is not the Qwen3.5 processor or conditional loader is wrong
text fixture contains image/video tokens or tensors
mtp_num_layers is not 1 or any of the 15 Qwen3.5 MTP tensors is missing
MTP weights fall back to random initialization, MTP loss is non-finite/missing, or MTP gradients are missing/non-finite/zero
ViT or aligner is trainable or receives gradients
USE_MCORE_GDN is not 1 or the runtime GDN implementation cannot be evidenced
NaN or Inf in loss or gradients
C2 does not complete real optimizer steps with optimizer/RNG checkpoint state
C3 TP2 is unsupported or hangs
C4 does not fresh-process resume from iteration 3 to 5
C5 does not reach the preregistered teacher-forced accuracy/loss thresholds by iteration 150
C5 main-language or MTP tensors do not change, or any frozen visual/aligner tensor changes
remote disk or VRAM headroom below contract
